title: cyclosorus paraphysatus
intro: Cyclosorus paraphysatus, commonly known as the 'Lion's Spine Fern', is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta, characterized by its unique fronds with spiny or serrated edges. The health benefits of Cyclosorus paraphysatus include its potential to treat various ailments, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions like antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
